data.title: Nurses for Full-Time Care Work in Norway
data.summary: Full-time care work in Norway supporting and treating patients with special support needs. The role is responsible and can be physically and psychologically demanding.

requirements.text: Suitable education in the social or healthcare field
Good stress tolerance and a calm working approach
requirements.question: What does 'good stress tolerance and a calm approach' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for stress tolerance and calmness without describing the situations where these are needed.

requirements.text: Handle challenging patient situations safely and professionally
requirements.question: What does 'handle challenging situations safely and professionally' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting seeks safe and professional handling of challenging situations without giving a concrete example.

requirements.question: What does 'good interpersonal and teamwork skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests interpersonal and teamwork skills without explaining how they are used in the role.

requirements.text: Genuine interest in demanding and meaningful care work
requirements.question: What does 'genuine interest in demanding and meaningful care work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for genuine interest in the work without describing how applicants might demonstrate it.

requirements.text: Experience with patients who need special support
